source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 7.0 cu. ft. Gas & Electric Dryers Technical Manual (WED4100/WGD4100)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Verify outlet voltage
steps.body: Electric: 240/208 VAC (2-phase or 3-phase). Gas: 120 VAC. Confirm green ACU status LED blinks slowly after power-up.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electric: 240/208 VAC (2-phase or 3-phase). Gas: 120 VAC. Confirm green ACU status LED blinks slowly after power-up.

steps.title: Access ACU
steps.body: Remove console/top panel. Restore power only for live voltage steps below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove console/top panel. Restore power only for live voltage steps below.

steps.title: 120 VAC at J7-4 (N) and J7-3 (L1)
steps.body: AC volts: black probe J7-4, red probe J7-3 — expect 120 VAC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: AC volts: black probe J7-4, red probe J7-3 — expect 120 VAC.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: No L1 at ACU — perform TEST #2 supply connections.

steps.title: +5 VDC at J4-1 vs J4-2
steps.body: Unplug J4. DC volts: red J4-1, black J4-2. Missing +5 VDC → replace ACU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug J4. DC volts: red J4-1, black J4-2. Missing +5 VDC → replace ACU.

steps.title: +12 VDC at J2-1 vs J2-4
steps.body: DC volts: red J2-1, black J2-4. +12 VDC actuates relays.
steps.sourceExcerpt: DC volts: red J2-1, black J2-4. +12 VDC actuates relays.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Isolate +12 VDC fault before replacing ACU.

steps.title: J2 isolation check
steps.body: Power off. Unplug J2 from ACU, restore power, retest J2 pins 1–4. If +12 returns, check HMI harness; if still missing, replace ACU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Unplug J2 from ACU, restore power, retest J2 pins 1–4. If +12 returns, check HMI harness; if still missing, replace ACU.

steps.title: ACU power verified
steps.oemOutcome: Line, +5 VDC, and +12 VDC present at ACU.
